title: Voicebox: Text-Guided Multilingual Universal Speech Generation at Scale
grouping: A 3 x 3 grid with no frames: columns are tasks (Denoising, Zero-shot TTS, Text-Only Sampling - bold underlined headers), rows are stages (Raw data, Model Input, Model Output - large plain row labels at left). Rows are separated by thick grey dashed horizontal rules that span the width.
shapes_depth: Audio is always a spectrogram thumbnail in a purple-orange-yellow colour map, never an icon or waveform. Masked audio is a flat solid yellow-orange rectangle that replaces the spectrogram span (inside a spectrogram for denoising, the whole strip for text-only sampling). Transcripts are short bold uppercase quoted fragments under or beside the audio. Small monospace labels name parts (noise, Content, Style, Ref, Target, Sample #1-3). Rectangular outlines mark audio roles: grey around the noisy span, blue around the reference audio, red around the generated target.
proposed_highlight: The model itself is never drawn; the method is shown through what it is given and what it returns. Colour links text to audio: content words and the generated Target box are red, style words and the Ref box are blue.
lesson: Explain an in-context generative model with a tasks x (raw data, model input, model output) grid of spectrograms, showing masking as a flat solid block and colouring each text snippet like the box around the audio it controls.
notes: Venue NeurIPS from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2306.15687). The spectrogram thumbnails are embedded rasters; measured photo_share reflects them. Annotation note (2026-11-15): Task-format/usage figure rather than an architecture diagram; no model blocks are drawn.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.note: figure shows task formats, not the network; Voicebox is a flow-matching infilling model trained on masked speech (architecture/training not drawn)

insights.structure: A 3 x 3 grid: columns are tasks (Denoising, Zero-shot TTS, Text-Only Sampling) with underlined bold headers, rows are Raw data / Model Input / Model Output separated by grey dashed horizontal rules.
insights.data: Audio is drawn as purple-orange spectrogram strips, masked spans as solid yellow-orange blocks, and transcripts as quoted capital text, with content text in red and style/reference text in blue.
insights.emphasis: Coloured outlines label roles: a grey 'noise' box on the noisy segment, blue 'Ref' boxes around the reference audio, and a red 'Target' box around the generated segment, matching the red/blue text colours.
insights.flow: Top to bottom within each column (raw -> input -> output), with no arrows; columns are read independently left to right.
insights.avoid: There are no arrows or model block at all, so the figure explains the input/output format but not how the model works; it should not be reused as a method overview.

arrangement.units: cells of a task-by-stage grid separated by dashed rules, no boxes
